caption: The drawing features two detailed black line illustrations of a wooden vanity table with a mirror, situated on an off-white or yellowed paper background. The left illustration depicts a front view of the table, showing a rectangular mirror with a decorative, carved frame mounted above a tabletop supported by four turned, ornamental legs. Below the tabletop are two drawers, each with two round handles or knobs and a central lock escutcheon. The legs are detailed with vertical grooves and rounded segments, extending to pointed tips with small round feet. The drawers are dimensioned, with measurements marked beside them and along the leg, specifying thickness and height in inches. The right illustration shows a side view, depicting the depth of the table and the mirror, as well as the compartments inside the lower drawer. A note reads "interior view, compartments in lower drawer," and the interior compartments are sketched as segmented sections within the bottom drawer. The overall drawing is technical, using straight and curved lines to indicate form, structure, and proportion, with hatching and cross-hatching for shading and texture. No color besides the black ink and paper background is used in the drawing.
title: Sewing and Work Table
